name: Portal hosted billing page drives signup and management (stripe-subscription-signup-2026-10-01 R-8, e2e layer)
summary: Run in the sibling portal checkout (~/papercupai-workspace/portal); canonical copy portal/docs/evidence/portal-billing-e2e-2026-10-01.json (portal commit 8e2cdeedb4f41fee11b763dfa7dfa88a6f0c64c2, sha256 5a5d73c8b1bb6196d84be11ef557bac37a9613f4221c5cd7fbade6affe9baa03). Six headless Chromium journeys passed in 8.1s on committed portal staging SHA 1b099f3bf3a0c41e5c99bb855a562e7abb36fe2b (spec and packages/ui/src/billing.tsx last changed in 1e95ea07036c0de78203ec0fdc9c36763c7354cb). The real BillingPortalPage is mounted under the URL-backed nuqs adapter; the hosted session and /api/hosted/billing/* are stubbed at the network edge.

assertions.evidence: A billing manager with no subscription sees the configured plans, picks one, and the page POSTs /api/hosted/billing/checkout and navigates to the returned Stripe Checkout URL.
Stripe's ?checkout=success return shows the pending notice, then the active plan once the subscription read reports the webhook-applied subscription.
An active subscription offers Manage billing, which POSTs /api/hosted/billing/portal and navigates to the returned Stripe customer-portal URL.
Stripe's ?checkout=canceled return renders the nothing-was-charged notice.
A member without billing:manage sees subscription status but no subscribe or manage controls.
A refused checkout shows the server's safe message and stays on the billing page.
